description: Send the platform team a request to join Gemalli — for a manufacturer, trader, sales agent, logistics or customs operator, broker or finance provider who wants to work with the platform rather than buy on it. Requires their name, email and phone: the team follows up by phone, so a number is needed. Ask them and pass exactly what they give you, never invent contact details. Use it only when the person has asked to be contacted, never to record someone you are merely discussing.

applicant_role.description: What they do: producer, trader, sales_agent, logistics, broker or finance.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the person.

locale.description: Two-letter language the person speaks, for the follow-up.

message.description: What they are looking for, in their own words where possible.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

operation_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Retrying with the SAME operation_id returns the original lead instead of creating a duplicate.

phone.description: Their phone in international format. Required.

source.description: Where this lead came from, e.g. your agent name — recorded for the sales team.

trade_direction.description: What they buy or sell, short free text.

name: submit_join_request
title: Request to join
